query: Use /aws-analytics:glue-data-quality to write a DQDL ruleset checking completeness, primary key uniqueness, regex patterns, and referential integrity on our Glue table.
Configure EvaluateDataQuality in an AWS Glue PySpark job to route failed rows to a quarantine S3 table and passed rows to our Silver Iceberg table.
Start a Glue Data Quality ruleset recommendation run (`start-data-quality-rule-recommendation-run`) on an existing Glue Data Catalog table.
Set up DQDL Analyzers for dynamic row-count anomaly detection and EventBridge alerts on Glue Data Quality evaluation failures.
Validate data freshness (`DataFreshness`) and custom SQL aggregate invariants (`CustomSql`) using AWS Glue Data Quality.
Configure Lake Formation LF-Tag access control policies and column masking on our Glue catalog.
Upgrade an Amazon MWAA environment from Apache Airflow 2.8 to Airflow 3.0.
Size an Amazon MSK Express cluster for 100 MB/s Kafka streaming.
